propositions: New rebar-mcp compose service must bind to loopback 127.0.0.1:8091 with fail-closed HTTP posture requiring TLS-at-edge acknowledgment and static bearer auth enabled
nginx /mcp/ location must proxy to a named upstream rebar_mcp with switchable server address via included mcp-upstream*.conf files, enabling atomic blue-green flipper rewrites

Health endpoint at /mcp/health must expose in_flight gauge counting only certified ops (review_plan/verify_completion/review_code/scan_spec) and return 200 without authentication despite REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=1
SIGTERM grace period must be 1200 seconds, allowing in-flight certified operations to complete before process exit; Docker stop_grace_period must be set to 1260s or greater

materialize-mcp-upstream.sh must install committed seed infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf to /etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf only-if-absent on fresh boot, before docker compose up, so nginx -t validation passes
Container healthcheck must curl loopback /health endpoint; docker-compose service must use restart: always with 1260s stop_grace_period covering 1200s app SIGTERM grace plus margin
